faqs.question: What is Landlord Insurance?
faqs.answer: Landlord Insurance protects rental property owners against property damage, liability risks, and rental income losses.

faqs.question: Does it cover tenant-caused damage?
faqs.answer: Coverage depends on policy terms and selected protection options.

faqs.question: Does it cover loss of rent?
faqs.answer: Many landlord policies provide rental income protection when covered events make the property uninhabitable.

faqs.question: Are legal expenses covered?
faqs.answer: Certain policies include legal expense protection.

faqs.question: Can multiple properties be insured?
faqs.answer: Yes, portfolio and multi-property coverage options are commonly available.

faqs.question: Does it cover natural disasters?
faqs.answer: Most comprehensive plans provide protection against covered natural disasters.
